obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your water account

results.segment: This letter confirms your appointment about your water account with Northgate Water on 19 February 2026 at 9.10am.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you can no longer attend, our reception team will be glad to offer the time to somebody else.
A refund of £74.10 was sent to your bank on 26 April and should have arrived within 3 days.
